Review the testing requests from business units before processing in chemical lab. - Review Client technical protocl to set up proper chemical testing to assign the scheme - Make sure all the informtaion, test method, LOQ, MDL, reporting limit and regulation consistence with client requirement - Keep the service delivery on time. - Reporting progress of tests and work regularly, and reporting the various problems arising in the work to supervisor timely - Participate in ad-hoc projects
